_comment: The conservative collection-role map for mxm-mono-08.
Only existing roles with the same meaning are claimed. Timbre is not pulse width, a
low-pass gate is not a resonant filter, and the five-stage CV/pulse network has no roles
in the current standard; all remain available through host automation and the plugin UI.
The built-in mono spring is part of this voice and therefore fills the existing reverb role.
lfo1.rate stays on the modulation frequency in both ranges; its high range reaches audio rates.
